creditHelp.title: How to track a credit card
creditHelp.description: Create a credit card account with your current debt. Record purchases as expenses from this account. Record repayments as a <transfer>transfer</transfer> from a debit account. Transfers between your own accounts count as neither income nor expenses, so purchases are counted only once.

delete.description: Only accounts without transactions can be deleted. Archive accounts with transaction history.
